description:
Who We Are

At IPID, we're building trust in global payments. Our account verification solutions help financial institutions, payment service providers, and enterprises verify account ownership before payments are sent, reducing fraud, improving compliance, and helping money reach the right recipient with confidence.

Founded by industry veterans from organisations including SWIFT and Thomson Reuters, IPID combines deep payments expertise with modern technology to help make global payments safer, simpler, and more reliable. As we continue to grow, we're looking for talented people who enjoy solving meaningful problems and want to make a visible impact in a fast-moving global fintech.

The Opportunity 

Build and lead IPID’s information security and risk capability, combining strategic judgement with hands-on execution. Establish a scalable operating model that protects the business, supports growth, earns customer trust and meets regulatory and assurance expectations.

This role exists to provide clear, accountable leadership for information security and technology risk. Reporting directly to the COO, you will serve as IPID’s senior security authority and responsible security representative with customers, partners, auditors and other external stakeholders. You will professionalise the function as the company scales and ensure security enables the business rather than operating as a compliance obligation.

Working closely with Tech, Product and Operations, you will define security accountabilities, challenge decisions where risk is material, and ensure agreed controls and remediation actions are implemented by the appropriate owners. You will build the structures, disciplines and governance practices required to support enterprise customers, external audits and future growth.

What You'll Be Doing 

  • Security Governance: Own and mature the organisation’s security policies, controls, certification and continuous audit readiness.
  • Security operations and resilience: Establish a scalable operating model for vulnerability management, incident response, remediation, security tooling and performance reporting, including ownership of ISO 27001 and SOC 2 Type 2 external auditing
  • Information security risk and third-party governance: Operate the security risk framework and risk register, oversee vendor and third-party risk, and ensure material risks are escalated and managed by accountable owners.
  • Customer and third-party assurance: Lead security due diligence, questionnaires and assurance discussions, representing the organisation credibly with customers, partners, auditors and other external stakeholders.
  • Leadership: Advise the COO and senior leadership, define security accountabilities, and lead the infosec team.

What We're Looking For

  • Minimum 8 years of relevant experience in information security, cyber security, technology risk or related disciplines, preferably in fintech, payments or regulated technology environments
  • Demonstrated experience building or maturing security programmes within fintech, SaaS, payments or technology organisations.
  • Experience scaling security capabilities and awareness within a growing organisation.
  • Strong experience with ISMS and other relevant frameworks, including owning ISO 27001 and SOC 2 Type 2 certification and external audits.
  • Strong experience with security governance and assurance, vendor and third-party risk, vulnerability and incident management, and customer and partner security due diligence, including supporting enterprise customer procurement and assurance processes.
  • Experience leading or building a security team and presenting security and technology risk to senior leadership.
  • Proven ability to resolve complex issues using sound judgement and business context
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills with technical and non-technical stakeholders
  • Intellectually curious and adaptable to new technology such as AI
  • Self-driven with the ability to work independently in a distributed setup
  • Fluent in English; additional languages are a plus
  • Professional certifications such as CISM, CRISC, CISSP or ISO 27001 Lead Implementer/Auditor are advantageous but not required.

What We Offer

  • Meaningful Impact – Help build trust in global payments by solving real-world challenges for financial institutions, fintechs, and businesses worldwide.
  • Learn from Industry Experts – Gain exposure to global customers, payment ecosystems, and experienced professionals across fintech, payments, and technology.
  • Ownership & Growth – Thrive in a collaborative environment where your contributions are visible, valued, and supported through opportunities for learning and career development.
